description: PRO. Licence details for an original licence number: name, device class, licence type and company. Each result includes `licence_no`, `licence_end_date` (null if none), and `active` (derived from the end date: no end date, or an end date today or later, means active). Includes `retrieved_at` (ISO 8601 UTC) and `source_updated_at` (when the upstream Health Canada data was fetched, including cache hits).
name: licence_detail
